items.prompt: At valid capacity c=3 and tail=0, what happens if (tail+1)%c is replaced by (tail+1)&(c-1)?

options.text: Both expressions give 1; the replacement is valid for every c.
options.why: For this exact state the mask is 2, and 1&2 is 0, not 1.

options.text: The mask gives 2, because that is c-1.
options.why: Bitwise AND combines bits; it does not simply return its right operand.

options.text: Modulo gives 1, but the mask gives 0.
options.why: Capacity 3 is not a power of two, so the mask can fail even on the first increment.
The capacity is 3 and both integer expressions are defined.
